MALE-READ ABSENT-MINDED PRESCRIPTION GP. Tall top-heavy crooked ink bean with two droopy crown lobes, two short grey clay moustache tips framing mouth, short open WHITE lapels with faded lilac collar, one pocket with ONE blunt red pencil tip. Whole silhouettes450-465px in512pxlogical cells, ample outer margins and32-40px clear row gaps. Contain all mirrors/coat tails/tubes/bags/tools/pads/pens/droplets in OWN cells. No overlapping/touching neighbors, cropped details or miniature bottom row. Coat props never overwhelm huge expressive face and bouncy ink body. No gridlines, background gradient, floor, shadow discs, checkerboard, halo, text or watermark. True alpha-zero transparent surroundings with opaque character interiors and clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio light on figures only.
